Find the perfect order of a distinct set of symbols to operate the system at its best!

Depending on the order is the system's performance.
Each symbol can only be present once in the output sequence.

Here are the four symbols with their performance properties:
A = yields best performance if not followed by more than one symbol
B = yields best performance if not preceded by symbols A and/or C
C = yields best performance unless it is the last symbol
D = yields best performance when being the first symbol

The optimal order for the given set of symbols would be D-B-A-C. This arrangement ensures that each symbol is used only once and maximizes the system's performance. Starting with D as the first symbol allows it to yield its best performance. Following it with B ensures that neither A nor C precede it, allowing B to also perform optimally. Placing A next guarantees that it won't be followed by more than one symbol, ensuring its top performance. Finally, ending with C prevents it from being the last symbol, which could hinder its performance.
